# TextField

A labelled text input with an icon, help text, inline error and valid states, and a password reveal.

`CLR.TextField` · Controls

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.TextField label="…" value="…" onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.TextField" label="…" value="…" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
